summary: This document describes a proxy mechanism that allows IPv6 nodes to use Duplicate Address Detection in point-to-multipoint networks with split-horizon forwarding, mainly DSL and fiber access. The first-hop router keeps a binding table of known addresses and responds when a node tries an address already in use by another.

eli5.summary: When someone picks a house number, a helper checks the list and says "taken!" if another neighbor already has it, even when neighbors cannot hear each other.

questions: duplicate address detection in split-horizon networks
